accounts.name: authority
docs: Must be the program's upgrade authority (blocks front-running of initialization).

accounts.name: asset
docs: New Core asset keypair, generated by the client.

accounts.name: graveyard
docs: Closed on rescue; rent goes to the rescuer.

accounts.name: new_asset
docs: New Core asset keypair, generated by the client.

accounts.name: bonus_asset
docs: Fresh keypair for a possible Bonus Bro. Required when the wheel has a Bonus Bro wedge.

errors.name: NotEnoughBags
errors.msg: Not enough bags, bro. Top up your TMB.

errors.name: SpinPending
errors.msg: A spin is already pending for this Bro.

errors.name: NoSpinPending
errors.msg: No spin is pending for this Bro.

errors.name: NotOwner
errors.msg: Signer does not own this Bro.

errors.name: RandomnessNotReady
errors.msg: Randomness has not been revealed yet.

errors.name: RandomnessAlreadyRevealed
errors.msg: Randomness was already revealed at request time.

errors.name: StaleRandomness
errors.msg: Randomness account is stale, foreign or malformed.

errors.name: MissingRektWedge
errors.msg: Prize table must contain exactly one REKT wedge.

errors.name: PoolReserveBreached
errors.msg: Payout would breach the pool reserve.

errors.name: CooldownActive
errors.msg: Transfer cooldown is still active for this Bro.

errors.name: SelfRescue
errors.msg: You cannot rescue your own Bro.

errors.name: NotBurned
errors.msg: This Bro is not in the graveyard.

errors.name: InvalidAsset
errors.msg: Asset is not a Bro from this collection or is not owned correctly.

errors.name: PriceNotSet
errors.msg: The TMB price has not been set yet.

errors.name: MissingAccounts
errors.msg: A required account (prize vault or bonus asset) was not supplied.

fields.name: eligible_slot
docs: Slot before which this (asset, owner) record may not spin (transfer cooldown).

fields.name: total_user_tmb
docs: Sum of every BroRecord.tmb_balance. Reward pool = vault TMB - total_user_tmb.

fields.name: prizes_ready
docs: False while a multi-transaction prize update is in flight (or after a failed one): spins are
blocked until `set_prizes(.., finalize = true)` validates the complete table.

fields.name: bonus_uri
docs: Metadata uri for Bonus Bro mints. Empty = copy the escrowed Bro's uri.

fields.name: amount
docs: TMB base units (Tmb), token base units (Token), count (BonusBro).

fields.name: mint
docs: Prize token mint (Token only).

fields.name: usd_value
docs: USD value snapshot (Token only), same units as `Thresholds::stock_value_low`.

fields.name: commit_slot
docs: Switchboard `seed_slot` the randomness was committed to.

fields.name: at_stake
docs: True when a loss on this spin burns the Bro.

fields.name: outcome
docs: 0 loss, 1 win, 2 stale-cancel loss

types.name: TmbPrice
docs: SOL price of TMB, kept in its own account so the (already deployed) Config layout is untouched.

fields.name: lamports_per_tmb
docs: Lamports per ONE whole TMB (10^decimals base units).

types.name: UpdateConfigArgs
docs: Every field optional; only `Some` fields are applied. Roles use `set_roles`, authority uses
propose/accept, pause uses `set_paused`, mint/collection are immutable after setup.
